Q0414

Wumen Huikai

A verified English rendering from the curated archive.

Quotes / Wumen Huikai / Q0414

English

Spring has a hundred flowers, autumn the moon; summer a cool breeze, winter the snow. If no idle affairs hang in the mind, every season is a fine season in the human world.
Thinker Wumen Huikai
School Zen
Source Gateless Gate (popular verse)
Theme Self
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Gateless Gate (popular verse), within the tradition of Zen. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of self, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Wumen Huikai's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
